checks.name: native record endpoint receives only preset and dashboard record id
five cards preserve backend values formatting and comparison without arithmetic
source action opens the exact server domain
changing period removes previous payload immediately
reversed response order cannot replace the latest selected period
monthly grouping and exact backend point count pass through unchanged
obsolete failure cannot replace a newer successful result
custom date draft invalidates a pending preset request without a new query
custom dates serialize raw ISO input and leave period policy to backend
current validation error is visible and leaves no stale numeric payload
refresh recovers after error with the same raw filters
navigation away ignores an in-flight reply
chart coordinate adapter preserves null gaps and true zero values
partial periods use a distinct marker and tooltips use backend display strings
empty periods draw no chart and do not turn gaps into zero
comparison arrows are labels only and do not recalculate percentages

scope: Production Owl component methods with stubbed services/hooks/canvas and deferred ORM. Verifies UI concurrency and faithful presentation, not business formulas or browser layout/lifecycle.
